verdict.rationale: Persona has a REST API for creating inquiries, retrieving reports, and webhooks for outcome notification, which an agent could programmatically drive (create sessions, poll via API, retrieve extracted data). However, there is no evidence of an MCP server/surface, no scoped/limited-credential API tokens for agent use, and no explicit 're-check' trigger endpoint documented. missing for 10: MCP surface or agent-specific integration, scoped/limited credential support for agents, explicit re-check/retrigger API endpoint, and any independent evidence of agent-driven usage.
